  • Constructor Details

    • NostrRTCRoom

      public NostrRTCRoom(RTCSettings settings, NostrRTCLocalPeer localPeer, NostrKeyPair roomKeyPair, NostrPool signalingPool, NostrTURNPool turnPool)
      Creates a room using the supplied signaling pool and RTC configuration.

      The constructor calls NostrPool.ensureRelay(String) for every URL in RTCSettings.getSignalingRelays().

      The caller owns signalingPool. To reuse its relay connections, pass the same pool to rooms with the same signaling relay list, and close it after those rooms have closed.

      Parameters:
      settings - RTC and signaling configuration for this room
      localPeer - local identity and session for this room
      roomKeyPair - key pair identifying the room
      signalingPool - caller-owned pool used for signaling
      turnPool - optional TURN pool, or null if TURN is unavailable
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if settings, localPeer, roomKeyPair, or signalingPool is null

      public void ban(NostrPublicKey peer)
      Ban a pubkey. Peers with the same pubkey will be disconnected and won't be able to reconnect until unbanned or the room is restarted.
      Parameters:
      peer - the peer to ban
